name: Rowan
why: A small direct-to-consumer label making cotton basics.
origin: Details of the company's founding are not published.

onething.n: verified — direct product page. American-grown Supima; 201 reviews against 49 for the next-most-reviewed piece, and the only style the house runs in four cuts plus a kids version

cities: 5 stores — Encinitas, Manhattan Beach, Newport Beach, Rancho Santa Fe, San Juan Capistrano · independent menswear shops, and its own site

notes.craft: Rowan's product pages state a country of make on every item sampled (Indonesia for wovens, denim and outerwear; Los Angeles/USA for tees and sweats) but name no factory and no mill. Nothing is owned. Country of make and little else: a 2.

craft_evidence.owned_d: Home page and Our Story name no factory, mill or workshop; Our Story says only 'Made in America whenever possible'. PDPs say 'Made down the road in Los Angeles' (tee) without naming a maker. No owned facility found.
craft_evidence.countries: Indonesia 5/7 ('Responsibly made in Indonesia': 1955 Abilene denim shirt, Axel flannel shirt jacket, Baron trucker jacket, Bray plaid shirt, Cameron Japanese fluid denim pant); USA 2/7 (Asher Standard Tee 'Made down the road in Los Angeles'; Acklen sweatpant 'Made in the USA'). Sample of 7 PDPs: shirts, tees, sweats, outerwear, trousers.
